pilot_erratum: The separate v1 pilot was invalidated for ambiguous nested names and allocation defaults. V2 uses explicit schemas, fresh seed 2026101800, unchanged scoring weights, and fresh sessions. No v1 score is pooled.
primary_selection: First valid submission attempt per core pack; no quality-based retries.
score: For each case, existing score_checks computes 100*passed weighted fields/total field weights. Decision/allocation fields weight5, other fields weight3. Each nested field must match completely. Family=arithmetic mean of its six cases. Index=arithmetic mean of all 11 family scores. No post-hoc weights or score cap.
repeat_policy: Exact core-1 prompt bytes in a fresh session. Repeat does not enter primary index; report absolute score delta and field-level agreement.
missing_output: After valid submission, required fields absent at terminal timeout/failure fail. Observer/infrastructure failures remain unresolved and block a complete index.
access_policy: Unsubmitted inaccessible providers have null score, explicit blocker and cause ALL-provider release gate to fail. Never treat non-access as measured ability zero.
scope: Controlled synthetic reasoning; not investment performance, live research truth, or continuous autonomous execution.
dependence: 22 related cases share one context; 66 cases are NOT 66 independent provider sessions. Six variants share each family template. Repeat is same data, not hidden holdout.
tool_profile: Native task-local computation where available; no account access, order submission, scheduling, external research or hidden keys. Product tool differences and labels disclosed.
fairness: All comparable providers receive identical bytes, budgets, input rules and keys. Brand-blind deterministic grading. No preferred-winner stopping rule.
release_gate: Every required provider must have all 66 primary and 22 repeat cases terminal with valid evidence, 11 numeric category scores and numeric 0..100 index. Any unavailable required provider blocks completion. User-held Supertake shown separately.
perfect_scores: Allowed if earned; difficulty is fixed before outputs. Never modify keys or difficulty after viewing results.
source_inspiration: Existing local per-criterion weighted scoring and separate trace/access clocks; no claim of external SOTA certification or financial expert validation.
